_README: SAMPLE DATA. Real buyer quotes that beat the ladder go here; this one example keeps the tests honest.

quotes.note: Example: a damaged unit (aftermarket screen + cracked back) quoted below the ladder.

advisories.text: Example advisory: TWO units of one model can fail a buyer for TWO different reasons (damage on one, carrier lock on the other). Check each unit, not the model, and do not read the unlocked row for a locked unit.
